name: Netac Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Netac Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of storage products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers solid state drives, external storage products, memory products, USB flash drives, memory cards, and peripheral products. Its products are used in mobile phones, tablets, computers, dashcams, cameras, drones, automotive electronics, smart homes, and wearable devices. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
